title: 39-year-old unvaccinated woman becomes 6th measles death in Pennsylvania
gist: A 39-year-old unvaccinated woman became Pennsylvania's sixth measles death in an outbreak of 1,124 cases across 41 counties. US cases hit 4,080 this year, the highest since 1991, and the US is expected to lose elimination status in November.

insights.claim: Pennsylvania has 1,136 measles cases this year (1,124 from the current outbreak since April), 218 hospitalizations, 41 of 67 counties affected, and 157 new cases in the latest week, with no sign of slowing.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Accelerating spread points to continued public-health strain and demand for health-system resources.

insights.claim: Six people have died in the outbreak, all unvaccinated, including a newborn, a 6-week-old, an 18-year-old, a 20-year-old, a 40-year-old and now a 39-year-old woman with underlying conditions.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Deaths across ages, not only infants, raise the severity profile of low-vaccination outbreaks.

insights.claim: US measles cases reached 4,080 this year, the highest since 1991, and Pennsylvania's outbreak is the largest since then.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Elimination-era gains are reversing, raising odds of continued outbreaks.

insights.claim: The US is widely expected to lose measles elimination status when PAHO experts review data in November.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Formal loss of status would be a reputational and policy event for US public health.

insights.claim: Under Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the CDC has reported only two of the six Pennsylvania deaths, and measles is attributed to misinformation and slipping vaccination rates.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Undercounting at the federal level reduces data reliability and signals policy risk for vaccine makers and public-health institutions.
insights.quote: Under anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has only included two of the six deaths so far in its reporting.

insights.claim: The US reported three measles deaths in 2025 after none since 2015.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Establishes the baseline reversal in measles mortality.

top_entities: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
